# OpenAI Sora Discontinuation: What the End of a Platform Means for Enterprise AI Strategy
OpenAI will discontinue the Sora web and app experiences on April 26, 2026, with the Sora API following on September 24, 2026 [[1]](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001152-what-to-know-about-the-sora-discontinuation).

## The News
OpenAI announced it will discontinue the Sora web and app experiences on April 26, 2026, and the Sora API on September 24, 2026 [[1]](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001152-what-to-know-about-the-sora-discontinuation).
